_comment: Runtime for the ALICE cocoindex jobs (ali-bot/cocoindex: the indexer cocoindex.nomad and the MCP server cocoindex-mcp.nomad). Python 3.12 with loadable SQLite extensions, the hash-locked dependencies, git. The code itself is not in the image: the jobspecs ship it as templates, so a code change needs no rebuild.

variables._comment_ALI_BOT_REF: Commit of alisw/ali-bot whose cocoindex/requirements-linux.lock is installed (master on 2026-11-16, 'Have separate log scanning helper'; the lock itself came in 76b0f710). Pinned, not a branch, so the image is reproducible; bump it when the lock changes. provision.sh refuses to build without it.
variables._comment_BASE: python:3.12-slim-bookworm, multi-arch index digest as of 2026-11-16. The official python images are configured with --enable-loadable-sqlite-extensions, which sqlite-vec needs; provision.sh checks it.

changes: CMD ["/opt/cocoindex/venv/bin/python", "-c", "import cocoindex, mcp, sqlite_vec; print('cocoindex runtime OK')"]
